delivery_local: Free, built and set up, in 1–2 days
delivery_nationwide: By courier in a box, 90% built, in 3–5 days
pickup: Collect from the shop, built and fitted, the next day
payment: Card or cash at the shop
confirm: We call within two hours of opening time to confirm the size, the stock and the delivery. Nothing is charged before that call.
stock_rule: Each bike has a number in stock, kept by the shop. An order holds the bike until the confirming call; a size at zero shows as out of stock.
